task: Event-time windowed aggregation engine (ae.stream) with watermarks, allowed lateness, tumbling/sliding/session windows and CRC-checked checkpoints
reasoning_summary: Defined window firing, lateness and session merging as precise rules in TASK.md, then wrote literal boundary tests, a brute-force oracle with a naive prefix watermark, checkpoint-at-random-points equivalence and corrupt-snapshot tests before the engine. process() computes every throwing value first and then applies, so failures leave state unchanged. One debug round: the oracle and engine disagreed on per-event window order, fixed by emitting windows in ascending start order.
